chief_complaint: Management of advanced chronic kidney disease (stage 4) and preparation for kidney transplantation
history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 53‑year‑old male with a long‑standing trajectory of progressive chronic kidney disease documented since 2010, now classified as stage 4 (eGFR 15‑29) and listed as awaiting kidney transplantation since 2015. He has hypertension treated with lisinopril, anemia treated with epoetin alfa (not captured in the medication list), and metabolic syndrome with obesity. Although the problem list records prediabetes, he is prescribed mixed‑dose insulin, indicating overt diabetes mellitus. He also has early‑onset familial Alzheimer’s disease on galantamine. Recent records (2020) highlight psychosocial stressors, limited social contact, intimate‑partner abuse, and a criminal record, all of which may affect adherence and transplant candidacy. Laboratory and vital sign data are largely missing, and the most recent A1c of 3.0% is implausible, suggesting data quality issues.
